Subject: Redwood discovery recap + next step (VP / CTO intro)

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Key takeaways
- Primary objective: reduce inference tail latency on user personalization pipeline (p95 target from ~820ms to <250ms)
- Data constraints: model inputs are private PII, must remain in customer VPC; SOC2 evidence and audit logs will be required during pilot
- Throughput: expected 60–80 qps during peak window, batchable but needs predictable latency for <200 tokens on avg

Immediate asks
1) Intro meeting with your CTO / VP of Engineering (to confirm architecture constraints and SSO/KMS expectations) — can you share Raj's availability next 10 business days?
2) Technical deep dive (60–90m) focused on infra and deployment options (private vs. dedicated) — we can propose two slots once we have Raj aligned

Attachments: a short discovery-notes summary (avery-discovery-notes.pdf) — included for your review.

Proposed times for exec intro (we'll hold these as tentative until you confirm): Tue 8/31 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/1 14:00–14:30 PT. If neither works, please send 2–3 windows that do.

Thanks — want to keep this lightweight and move to concrete scheduling so we can scope a pilot.

—
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
